system.summary: A three-digit syllabary in alphabetical bands (a 6-8, b 14-21 ... z 320-333), each band headed by names (Cesarz 42, Moskwa 160, Turcy 271), with Roman-numeral codes (XVIII = Hospodar Multanski); dot-separated, clear words between; Polish.
system.sibling_key: none: syllabary rebuilt from the interlinear glosses of the three letters (syllabary.tsv)

prior_solution.where: the contemporary interlinear decipherments; not printed

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied and the target assigned in a brief (catalogue entry 333). No target-specific intervention.
tools: DECODE JSON API and filesrv download

solution.what: DECODE metadata for R7460-R7507 by API; 130 images of R7462-R7507 with the session cookie; no key or decryption file on any record.

Subagents transcribed the unprinted Sieniawski pieces with their interlinear decipherments: R7475 (alphabetical homophonic table rebuilt from the gloss), R7476 and R7484-R7485 (Chomentowski's 3-digit syllabary, syllabary.tsv), R7481-R7482 (key B).

R7476: faint glosses re-read at high contrast (34 crops), then a language pass using the alphabetical bands of the syllabary: 84.8% then 88.5% of 1,622 tokens read; letter re-dated to May-Aug 1714 (code XVIII glossed 'Hospodar Multański', Brâncoveanu in Yedikule).
R7481, R7482, R7484, R7485 checked token by token against gloss and key (encipherment slips settled): 99.6%, 100%, 95.9%, 100% read as sense.
R7484 pass 3: code 76 = ferman from two glosses, the f band and R7476; 'stambulscy'; LM scoring and the embassy literature (Perłakowski 2020) gave nothing for the rest: 96.5%.

R7476 passes 4-6: unread stretches re-transcribed digit by digit at 2.5-3x (closed 7 read as 4 six times, other look-alikes), glosses re-read, Polish words scored with lang/ pl-modern, names checked against Perłakowski 2020: 88.5% -> 88.9% -> 92.9% -> 94.4% (1,531 of 1,621); codes 135 Kanclerz, 215 Porta, 280 u, 310 x added.

Chomentowski embassy 1712-14 for names as cribs: Perłakowski 2020 names Jan Spiegel ('Pan Szpigieł') and Franciszek Goltz; no other name matched the unread syllables (Poniatowski, Kapudan, kajmakam, Bender, Białogród, Gdańsk, Pułtawa tried).

R7476 pass 7: candidate words (Ottoman/Tatar offices, Latin, Swedish and Polish names, old Polish spellings) aligned to the code bands with at most one slip per word and scored with lang/ pl-modern: 7 tokens accepted ('od Porty', 'renuebat', 'rzeczy(?)'), the rest rejected as needing letters the code does not give: 94.9% (1,538 of 1,621), 2 tokens short of 95%.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 from sieniawski1708 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the Vienna-Schenck letters are schenck1706; the Sieniawski letters are one entry per key: key A (sieniawski1708), key B (turculet1709), the R7475 table (r7475), the Chomentowski syllabary (chomentowski1713).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): transcriptions R7476.txt (pass-5 digit corrections marked), R7484.txt, R7485.txt; decryptions R7476_reading.txt, R7484_reading.txt, R7485_reading.txt (pass files R7476_pass2/pass5, R7484_pass2, R7485_pass2 hold the checks); syllabary.tsv not linked as key_file since the contribution is not key recovery.

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): R7484_reading.txt and R7485_reading.txt read. R7484 reads with scattered holes; in R7485 the cipher passage reads in full and the holes are in the pale clear body (pp. 116-117 clear, not cipher). Audit grade C overturned to A for both; claim unchanged.
v3 verification: R7476_reading.txt was scored with its header and notes (0.578). Reading/Notes headings added; body 0.651 explicit-hole (plain 0.143, small Polish word list). Keeps read.

R7476.txt parsed into per-line code/gloss/key streams (r2b_chom_stream.py); the pass-3 reading aligned letter by letter with the stream and each word re-spelt from its figures (r2b_chom_restore.py), then checked line by line by hand; 5 readings improved from the figures (ongi, swoie, ktoro on, odpowiedzielem, word code wozy); about 40 '(?)' words became [?word] and about 30 unenciphered letters were bracketed. v2_score: explicit holes 0.651 -> 0.524, below the bar: demoted to decoded, not read; English translation R7476_en.md written.

texts.label: R7476, Constantinople, May-August 1714 (by content)
texts.summary: Probably Chomentowski to Hetman Sieniawski from Constantinople, dated May-August 1714 because code XVIII is glossed Hospodar Multański (Brâncoveanu, held in Yedikule from April 1714). New passages include "on z tąd nie ruszy, póki mu Porta nie da takiego konwoju", "z listu przejętego", "sołtan gałga uciekł do Czerkies" and "donieść Jmci Panu Kanclerzowi Koronnemu".
texts.note: 23 Oct 2026 (r2b): the pass-3 reading was in modernised spelling and marked doubtful words '(?)', which the explicit-hole score did not count. Restored to the writer's spelling (clear words as transcribed, code words as glossed; r2b_chom_restore.py + hand check, R7476_reread_log.md), doubtful words marked [?word] and letters the figures do not carry bracketed: explicit-hole share 0.524 (33/63 sentence windows; plain 0.079, hole rate 0.143), below the 0.60 bar. Kept as a partial reading (R7476_reading.txt, English R7476_en.md). The residue (p.31 L19-34, p.32 L9-36) rests on glosses unreadable at 3-3.5x in passes 4-7.

texts.label: R7484, Adrianople, 9 May 1713
texts.summary: Chomentowski, voivode of Mazovia and Polish envoy at the Porte, to Hetman Sieniawski: the Kapudan Pasha, made vizier, began to change course; a public divan on 24 April declared war sub ignoto nomine, with fear of a march on Chocim and the envoys sent to Yedikule; on the 26th the vizier was deposed and strangled, so things are in confusion.

reading_review.note: 23 Oct 2026 (r2k): reading restored from modernised Polish to the writer's spelling (code values, the glosser's o->a normalisations undone as in R7476: mowio, widzoc, bedoc, dotod; clear words as transcribed), slips emended in brackets, '(?)' words now [?word], aligned word by word with R7484.txt (R7484_reread_log.md). v2_score explicit holes 0.739 (17/23; plain 0.087, hole rate 0.094); sentences hold; 18 of 513 cipher tokens unread; emended letters under 1%.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 91.6% of the words of R7484_reading.txt read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: R7485, undated (1713/14)
texts.summary: Chomentowski to Sieniawski; the cipher passage is also written out in clear at the head of the page: the Turks will not believe the Seraskier and the Khan, and the Seraskier wrote to the hospodar of Wallachia to persuade the envoy to go to Bender.
